name: jira-ai-pm-editor
description: A VS Code extension for Project Managers and Scrum Masters to summarize Jira sprint health with optional AI assistance.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Jira AI PM Editor can read Jira data and optionally send issue summaries to VS Code Language Model providers, so it should only run in trusted workspaces.

jiraAiPm.jiraBaseUrl.description: Selected Jira Cloud base URL. OAuth connections fill this automatically after site selection.

jiraAiPm.jiraAuthMethod.description: Jira authentication method. API token is simple for local/internal use; OAuth 2.0 (3LO) is available for distributable or per-user consent flows.

jiraAiPm.jiraOAuthClientId.description: Atlassian OAuth 2.0 (3LO) client ID for the Jira integration.

jiraAiPm.jiraOAuthRedirectUri.description: Atlassian OAuth callback URL registered for this extension, for example vscode://local.jira-ai-pm-editor/atlassian-oauth.

jiraAiPm.jiraOAuthScopes.description: Space-separated Atlassian OAuth scopes requested by AI PM.

jiraAiPm.jiraOAuthTokenBrokerUrl.description: Optional HTTPS token broker endpoint for broad production distribution. Leave empty for individual or small internal use so OAuth stays local with VS Code SecretStorage.

jiraAiPm.jiraOAuthCloudId.description: Selected Atlassian cloud ID for OAuth Jira API calls.

jiraAiPm.jiraOAuthAccessTokenExpiresAt.description: Internal expiry timestamp for the current Jira OAuth access token.

jiraAiPm.defaultJql.default: sprint in openSprints() ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC
jiraAiPm.defaultJql.description: Default JQL used when fetching Jira issues.

jiraAiPm.maxIssues.description: Maximum number of Jira issues to include in a sprint brief.

jiraAiPm.includeSensitiveJiraFields.description: Fetch Jira reporter names, comments, and changelog entries for richer local-only heuristics. These fields are not sent to VS Code Language Model providers by AI PM.

jiraAiPm.assistantProvider.description: AI assistant provider used for sprint briefs and assignee tile advice.

jiraAiPm.vscodeLanguageModelVendor.description: Optional VS Code Language Model vendor selector, for example copilot. Leave empty to use any available provider.

jiraAiPm.vscodeLanguageModelFamily.description: Optional VS Code Language Model family selector, for example gpt-4o. Leave empty to use any available family.

jiraAiPm.vscodeLanguageModelId.description: Optional exact VS Code Language Model id selector. Leave empty unless you need a specific model.
